data.title: EBOS Releases FY2026 Climate Statement Under New Zealand Climate Standards
data.description:
EBOS Group Limited ( (NZ:EBO) ) has provided an announcement.

EBOS Group Limited has released its FY2026 Climate Statement, the third mandatory climate-related disclosure prepared under Aotearoa New Zealand Climate Standards for the year to 30 June 2026. The report targets investors and creditors, outlining material climate-related matters alongside the Group’s wider ESG activities.

The statement details EBOS’ governance, risk management, strategy, metrics and targets for climate-related risks and opportunities, while acknowledging significant uncertainties and reliance on evolving data and third-party inputs. It highlights key risk factors that could affect the Group’s transition plan and emissions targets, including regulatory changes, approval and infrastructure risks for planned solar arrays, and the availability and cost of carbon credits, certificates and renewable energy, particularly at leased sites where landlord cooperation is required.

data.title: Reward Minerals Wins Approval for First Drilling at Newfoundland Gold-Copper Prospect
data.description:
Reward Minerals Limited ( (AU:RWD) ) has shared an update.

Reward Minerals has secured statutory approvals from Newfoundland and Labrador authorities to commence a maiden seven-hole diamond drilling campaign at the Jackpot gold-copper prospect within its Mountain Pond Project in Canada. Jackpot hosts an outcropping mineralised quartz vein in a shear zone, with historic and recent rock chip assays returning high-grade gold and copper, underscoring the prospect’s potential.

Site access refurbishment and drill pad preparation are scheduled to start in mid-September ahead of drilling, marking the first-ever drill test at Mountain Pond. Recent soil sampling has strengthened the gold anomaly at the nearby Bingo prospect and defined a new anomaly at High Stakes, together forming a 1.2km prospective corridor that will guide Reward’s short- and medium-term exploration priorities across the project.
